touches.text: Install and upgrades live here: the installer machine walks the host-seam intentions, verifies each, offers what's missing, applies, re-verifies. If xyz library needs an update, this is the component that does it. Any change to what the host is goes through here (6.6.3.1.1).

The line is using vs changing. Any device may USE the OS's services (write a file, open a socket, start or stop its own unit with systemctl). CHANGING what the host is (installing or updating systemd unit files, packages, udev rules, cron entries) goes through Recovery. Eg Cairn restarts the bus itself; putting the bus's unit file in place goes through Recovery.
Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
intentions_model_compiler: copies every intention into intentions-congruency-lab/. WHY: so that one folder can regrow the system on a bare machine. USERS: Cairn (cairn compile).
